description: 3 straight weekly closes with the closing price being no more than 1.5-2% higher/lower than the closing price of the previous week.
atlas_query: ( cash ( ( cash ( latest high > 100 and latest sma( latest volume , 50 ) >= 10000 and latest close > latest ema( latest close , 50 ) and abs( ( weekly max( 3 , weekly close ) / weekly min( 3 , weekly close ) - 1 ) * 100 ) <= 2 and( 3 weeks ago max( 12 , weekly close ) / 3 weeks ago min( 12 , weekly close ) - 1 ) * 100 >= 30 ) ) ) )

filters.verbatim: daily abs( ( weekly max( 3 ,  weekly close ) / weekly min( 3 ,  weekly close ) - 1 ) * 100 ) <= 2
daily abs( ( weekly max( 3 ,  weekly high ) / weekly min( 3 ,  weekly low ) - 1 ) * 100 ) <= 10
( 3 weeks ago max( 12 ,  weekly close ) / 3 weeks ago min( 12 ,  weekly close ) - 1 ) * 100 >= 30
